blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The University of the Visayas (UV) Green Lancers reminded the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (CESAFI) why they are the league’s four-peat defending champions. UV overpowered its archrival, the University of Cebu (UC) Webmasters, 80-65, in the CESAFI Season 26 collegiate basketball tournament on Sunday, September 27, at the Cebu Coliseum. […]...
